title: Xenial Lamb Stew
description: A hearty, comforting Chinese-inspired lamb stew made with tender lamb and springy vegetables.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped spring onions and cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add the turmeric and red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stew and bring to a boil.
Return the lamb to the pot and cover.
Transfer the pot to the oven and cook at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Shred the lamb with two forks and return it to the pot.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve.
